name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1916: He said the cursor is not symmetric across the platform and that some areas show a regular mouse cursor. Measured on both surfaces before writing a line: the board has carried the gauntlet on everything since v605 and an audit of 2778 interactive elements across 12 tabs found zero on the OS arrow, while the console had zero custom cursor declarations and 69 plain pointer rules - the asymmetry was the whole console. One asset serves both now, the exact bytes decoded out of the board inline data URI, pinned byte-identical by a test so the hand cannot drift. The closed hand is NOT done and is named rather than faked: the extracted sprite is 16 frames of the open hand idling with no fist in it. Separately, a different model family was shown the sweep panel cold and said the worst thing was that the green button never states its consequence - it now carries the arithmetic and both escape routes.
